Tiny Fixture Document Two

1.  Bicycles

   A bicycle chain needs oil every few hundred kilometres. A dry chain
   wears out the cassette.

2.  Tyres

   Check tyre pressure weekly. Low pressure causes punctures.

Appendix A.  Tools

   A pump and a chain tool fit in a saddle bag.

A.1.  Pump Types

   Floor pumps are faster than hand pumps.
